activation_metadata.title: Flash Flood and GLOF in Nepal (August 2026)
activation_metadata.reference_event_description: Landslide / mudflow / scouring debris flow path mapped via photo-interpretation.

independent_sar_observation.sensor: Sentinel-1 RTC (C-band SAR, 10m grid, Orbit 19 Descending)

spatial_evaluation_footprint.footprint_reconciliation_note: The exact geometric intersection of the EMSR927 AOI03 polygon and the challenge AOI is 507.56 ha (5.08 km2). Projected onto the 10m master metric grid (all_touched=False), exactly 50,760 pixel centroids fall inside the boundary (507.60 ha). The difference is 426.5 m2 (0.0084%) due to discrete half-pixel boundary quantization. The earlier 24.45 km2 figure resulted from an axis-aligned bounding-box intersection, whereas AOI03 is an irregular non-axis-aligned polygon.

evaluation_methodology_reconciliation.primary_evaluation: Raw-pixel confusion matrix (evaluates direct un-sieved 10m raster outputs).
evaluation_methodology_reconciliation.postprocessed_evaluation: Vector-derived statistics (evaluates polygonized GeoJSON after min_area_sqm=500.0 spatial sieving in mask_to_geojson_features, which removes isolated <5-pixel noise clusters).

scientific_integrity_and_semantic_diverg.semantic_target_relationship: INDEPENDENT SPATIAL-OVERLAP ANALYSIS (Semantically and Temporally Divergent)
scientific_integrity_and_semantic_diverg.analytical_independence: EMSR927 vector products were accessed solely as a post-inference independent external comparison. They were strictly isolated from pipeline training, preprocessing, inference, threshold selection, and post-filtering.
scientific_integrity_and_semantic_diverg.semantic_divergence_statement: Because SNUNet-ECAM targets standing flood water (Class 2) and CEMS mapped mass-movement/debris scars (6-Mass Movement) from earlier sub-meter optical imagery (27 August 2026), the two products have fundamentally different target semantics and observation dates (5 September 2026 for Sentinel-1 SAR). This comparison is therefore an independent spatial-overlap analysis comparing physical candidate change and neural water extents with mapped event deposits, rather than a direct flood-water accuracy validation.
scientific_integrity_and_semantic_diverg.temporal_divergence_statement: CEMS optical imagery was acquired on 27 August 2026 (1 day post-peak); Sentinel-1 post-event SAR was acquired on 5 September 2026 (9 days later), over which time transient flash floods drained completely into normal stream channels.
scientific_integrity_and_semantic_diverg.radar_scouring_physical_mechanism: The classical radar backscatter drop detector (delta_VV < -3 dB) captures severe microwave volume scattering loss and surface scouring along the debris track, successfully identifying 37.58 ha (vector) / 40.32 ha (raw) of the mass-movement corridor with 65-68% precision.

verified_checkpoint_classes.2: Flood water (inundated terrain / temporary flood extent)

snunet_class_mapping_audit.positive_prediction_semantics: The neural positive mask strictly evaluates original Class 2 (Flood Water). Original Class 1 (Permanent Water) is isolated as a distinct reference baseline and excluded from flood metrics.

snunet_neural_flood_water_raw.layer_description: Un-sieved raw pixel predictions where argmax == 2 (Flood Water).

snunet_neural_flood_water_vector.prediction_layer: SNUNet-ECAM Neural Flood Water (Polygonized Vector, Class 2)
snunet_neural_flood_water_vector.layer_description: Polygonized flood extent from snunet_flood_extent.geojson (500m2 area threshold applied).

classical_radar_change_raw.layer_description: Physical radar backscatter reduction candidate change pixels before spatial sieving.

classical_radar_change_vector.layer_description: Polygonized candidate flood extent from baseline_candidate_flood.geojson (500m2 threshold).
